# APM Demand Forecasting & Scenario Planning - PoC data

**All data is synthetic.** Generated by `src/generate_apm.py` (seed 42); output in `data/model/`.

## Calendar
| Weeks | Dates (2026) | Use |
|---|---|---|
| 1-4 | 05 Jan - 01 Feb | Train |
| 5 | 02 - 08 Feb | Calibration (champion choice, quantile calibration) |
| 6 | 09 - 15 Feb | Hold-out (has actuals; contains the storm day 12 Feb) |
| 7 | 16 - 22 Feb | Future (forecast only; maintenance 18 Feb 10:00-14:00) |

## Star schema (grain: date x 15-min interval x station x direction)
| Table | Grain | Key columns |
|---|---|---|
| Fact_APM_Ridership | interval x station x direction | DateKey, Time15Key, StationKey, DirectionKey, Boardings |
| Fact_APM_Forecast | + model x scenario | ..., ModelVersionKey, ScenarioKey, Forecast_Pax |
| Fact_Station_Capacity | interval x station x direction | ..., Trains_Planned, Boarding_Cap_Per_Train, Capacity_Pax |
| Fact_Flight_Schedule | date x interval x terminal station x flight bank | DateKey, Time15Key, StationKey, BankKey, Flights, Scheduled_Pax |
| Dim_Date (daily) / Dim_Time15 (96) / Dim_Station / Dim_Direction / Dim_Flight_Bank / Dim_Scenario / Dim_ModelVersion | | |

## Key assumptions
- Loop line RCC -> T1 -> T2 -> T3 -> ITB -> RCC; riders take the shortest direction.
- Arrivals: 28 % ride to RCC and 8 % to another terminal, 15-90 min after landing.
  Departures: 22 % ride RCC -> terminal, 90-150 min before departure. Plus small ambient staff demand.
- Scenarios: Low / Most-Likely / High = P10 / P50 / P90 of the model (residual quantiles calibrated out-of-sample on week 5).
- Capacity = trains per 15 min (by day-part) x boarding capacity per train; sized so ~2 % of normal training intervals saturate. Demand is unconstrained (no queueing modelled).
- Hidden events the model cannot know: 30 Jan pre-holiday surge (+20 %), 12 Feb storm (25 % cancellations).

## Models
- Seasonal Profile: mean by (weekday/weekend, 15-min slot).
- Schedule-driven Ridge (numpy): ridge regression of boardings on lagged scheduled arrivals and leading scheduled departures of every terminal. Champion chosen on week-5 validation.
- statsmodels/Prophet were not used (blocked by the host's app-control policy); numpy implementations only.
